intro: The Jasmine Green Tea (22 oz) from CAVA offers a refreshing, calorie-free beverage option made with organic jasmine green tea. This elegant drink provides a perfect complement to any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/), delivering delicate floral notes and antioxidant benefits. At just $3.85, it stands as a sophisticated alternative to sugary drinks while keeping your meal light and healthy.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.85 for a generous 22 oz serving, the Jasmine Green Tea contains 0 calories, 0g protein, 0g carbohydrates, and 0g fat. This makes it an ideal choice for those monitoring their caloric intake while enjoying a flavorful beverage. The zero-calorie profile allows you to enjoy bold flavors from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) without additional dietary concerns.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this beverage apart is its use of organic jasmine green tea, delivering authentic flavor without artificial ingredients or sweeteners. The natural combination of green tea and jasmine flowers creates a delicate, aromatic experience. Unlike sweetened options on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks), this tea offers pure, clean refreshment that enhances rather than overwhelms your meal with sophisticated taste.
nutritionFacts: With a complete nutritional profile of 0 calories, 0g protein, 0g carbohydrates, and 0g fat, the Jasmine Green Tea is the ultimate guilt-free beverage. The organic green tea base provides natural antioxidants and catechins known for health benefits. This nutrient composition makes it compatible with various dietary plans, from keto to low-carb, complementing selections from the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator).
whatsInside: The Jasmine Green Tea contains just one simple ingredient: organic jasmine green tea. This pure formulation means no added sugars, artificial flavors, preservatives, or sweeteners. The organic certification ensures quality cultivation practices, while the jasmine flowers naturally infuse the green tea with their signature floral aroma. This straightforward ingredient list appeals to health-conscious diners seeking transparency and purity.
tasteLike: The Jasmine Green Tea delivers a delicate balance of smooth green tea with subtle floral jasmine notes. The taste is light and refreshing, with natural sweetness from the jasmine flowers without any added sugar. The green tea base provides a gentle earthiness that is not bitter or astringent. This creates a clean, aromatic finish that refreshes the palate between bites of flavorful Mediterranean dishes.
customize: While the Jasmine Green Tea comes perfectly balanced as-is, you can customize your beverage experience by requesting light ice for stronger tea flavor or extra ice for maximum refreshment. Some guests enjoy adding a squeeze of fresh lemon for citrus brightness. The tea pairs beautifully with any combination from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) and [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) without competing flavors.
pairsWell: This refreshing tea pairs exceptionally well with rich, flavorful dishes from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like spiced lamb or grilled chicken. The clean, palate-cleansing properties complement bold Mediterranean spices and creamy dips. It also works wonderfully alongside lighter grain bowls or pitas, providing subtle refreshment without overwhelming delicate flavors. The zero-calorie profile makes it perfect for balancing heartier meal choices.
healthyChoice: The Jasmine Green Tea stands as one of the healthiest beverage choices available, offering zero calories while providing beneficial antioxidants. Green tea is renowned for metabolism support, mental clarity, and potential health benefits. The organic ingredient eliminates pesticide concerns, making it suitable for clean eating approaches. This beverage allows you to stay hydrated without compromising dietary goals or adding empty calories.
howToOrder: Order the Jasmine Green Tea (22 oz) directly at the beverage station when building your meal. Simply request it alongside your bowl, pita, or salad creation. The 22 oz size provides ample refreshment throughout your meal. You can also ask about availability when ordering online or through delivery services. The straightforward ordering process makes it easy to add this healthy option.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Classic Lemonade (22 oz) at 360 calories or Blueberry Lavender (22 oz) at 190 calories, the Jasmine Green Tea offers zero calories while still delivering complex flavor. While sweetened beverages provide immediate taste satisfaction, the tea offers sophisticated refreshment without sugar crashes. The $3.85 price point matches alternatives while providing superior health benefits and authentic organic ingredients for mindful beverage choices.
whoShouldTry: The Jasmine Green Tea is perfect for health-conscious diners, green tea enthusiasts, and anyone avoiding added sugars. It suits those following keto, low-carb, or calorie-restricted diets without sacrificing taste. Individuals seeking antioxidant benefits or caffeine for gentle energy will appreciate this choice. Anyone wanting a sophisticated, refreshing beverage to complement Mediterranean flavors should definitely try this organic offering.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking a flavorful, zero-calorie beverage option at CAVA. The organic jasmine green tea delivers authentic taste, health benefits, and refreshing qualities at a reasonable $3.85 price point. It provides a sophisticated alternative to sweetened drinks while complementing the bold Mediterranean flavors throughout the menu. This elegant tea elevates your dining experience without compromising your nutritional goals.
